an6.39:1.3: Lobho nidānaṃ kammānaṃ samudayāya, doso nidānaṃ kammānaṃ samudayāya, moho nidānaṃ kammānaṃ samudayāya.
an6.39:1.5: atha kho bhikkhave lobhā lobho 'va samudeti.
an6.39:1.7: atha kho bhikkhave dosā doso 'va samudeti.
an6.39:1.9: atha kho bhikkhave mohā moho 'va samudeti.
an6.39:1.10: Na bhikkhave lobhajena kammena dosajena kammena mohajena kammena devā paññāyanti, manussā paññāyanti, yā vā pan' aññā pi kāci sugatiyo,
an6.39:1.11: atha kho bhikkhave lobhajena kammena dosajena kammena mohajena kammena nirayo paññāyati, tiracchānayoni paññāyati, pettivisayo paññāyati, yā vā pan' aññā pi kāci duggatiyo.
an6.39:1.12: Imāni kho bhikkhave tīṇi nidānāni kammānaṃ samudayāya. 3.
an6.39:2.3: Alobho nidānaṃ kammānaṃ samudayāya, adoso nidānaṃ kammānaṃ samudayāya, amoho nidānaṃ kammānaṃ samudayāya.
an6.39:2.5: atha kho bhikkhave alobhā alobho 'va samudeti.
an6.39:2.7: atha kho bhikkhave adosā adoso 'va samudeti.
an6.39:2.9: atha kho bhikkhave amohā amoho 'va samudeti.
an6.39:2.10: Na bhikkhave alobhajena kammena adosajena kammena amohajena kammena nirayo paññāyati, tiracchānayoni paññāyati, pettivisayo paññāyati, yā vā pan' aññā pi kāci duggatiyo,
an6.39:2.11: atha kho bhikkhave alobhajena kammena adosajena kammena amohajena kammena devā paññāyanti, manussā paññāyanti, yā vā pan' aññā pi kāci sugatiyo.
